corpus: BID SCHEDULE -- NORTHVIEW LOGISTICS CENTER (synthetic, illustrative only). This schedule of values is submitted as part of the base bid for the Northview Logistics Center project. All unit prices are quoted in United States dollars and apply to the quantities established in the bid documents unless a written change order is issued. Sitework and earthwork, including clearing, grubbing, mass excavation, and rough grading, is priced at $4.25 per square foot of disturbed area. Cast-in-place concrete, including footings, foundation walls, and slab on grade, is priced at $18.75 per square foot and is scheduled for a duration of 6 weeks from notice to proceed on that scope. Structural steel framing, including the primary frame, secondary framing, and bracing, is priced at $32.00 per square foot and is scheduled for a duration of 8 weeks. Standing seam metal roofing, including underlayment and flashing, is priced at $14.50 per square foot. Perimeter security fencing, including posts, fabric, and gates, is priced at $46.00 per linear foot. Curb and gutter along the site access drive is priced at $28.00 per linear foot. The finish hardware allowance carried in this bid is $65,000 and shall be adjusted by change order if actual selections exceed the allowance. Mobilization, including move-in of equipment, temporary facilities, and site setup, is a lump sum of $185,000. Retainage shall be withheld at 10 percent of each progress payment until the project reaches 50 percent completion, after which retainage shall be reduced to 5 percent of each progress payment for the remainder of the contract. The owner's contingency carried in this bid is 8 percent of the base contract sum and is to be used only for owner-directed changes. Liquidated damages for failure to reach substantial completion by the contract completion date are assessed at $2,500 per calendar day. The overall project schedule duration from notice to proceed to substantial completion is 42 weeks.
